title: Russian Strike Near Polish Border Raises Tensions
subtitle: Western leaders condemn attack on train as NATO vows to increase support for Ukraine

summary.en: A Russian drone strike hit a passenger train near the Polish border shortly after Western officials passed through. Former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other security experts were on a previous train that may have been the intended target. NATO and EU leaders have condemned the attack, calling it an attempt to intimidate Western supporters. Despite the danger, officials stated that this action would not stop their support for Ukraine. Meanwhile, Ukraine continues to face widespread drone and missile attacks across the country.
summary.zh: 俄羅斯的一架無人機在西方官員通過後不久，擊中了波蘭邊境附近的一列客運列車。英國前首相強生與其他安全專家搭乘了前一班列車，該列車可能是原本的攻擊目標。北約與歐盟領導人譴責此次攻擊，稱其為恐嚇西方支持者的企圖。儘管面臨危險，官員們表示此舉不會阻止他們對烏克蘭的支持。與此同時，烏克蘭全國仍持續面臨大規模的無人機與飛彈襲擊。

paragraphs.en: A Russian drone strike hit a passenger train near the Ukraine-Poland border on Sunday, causing alarm among Western leaders. The attack targeted a train at Yahodyn station, hitting the engine shortly after a group of high-level diplomats and former leaders had passed through the same area. According to BBC News, no passengers were hurt because everyone had been moved to safety just 15 minutes before the strike. Ukrainian railway officials noted that the diplomatic train carrying former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other security advisers had left the station earlier than planned, possibly avoiding a direct hit.
paragraphs.zh: 週日，俄羅斯的一場無人機襲擊擊中了烏克蘭與波蘭邊境附近的一列客運列車，引發西方領導人的警覺。此次攻擊的目標是亞戈丁 (Yahodyn) 車站的一列火車，在該區域剛有一群高階外交官與前任領導人通過後，隨即擊中了火車頭。根據英國廣播公司新聞網 (BBC News) 報導，由於所有乘客在襲擊發生前 15 分鐘已被轉移至安全地帶，因此無人受傷。烏克蘭鐵路官員指出，載有英國前首相強生 (Boris Johnson) 及其他安全顧問的外交列車比預定時間更早離開車站，可能因此避開了直接命中。

paragraphs.en: This incident has brought the reality of the war closer to the borders of the European Union and NATO. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk held an emergency meeting to discuss the situation, stating that Russian actions are moving closer to the Polish border. According to The Guardian, the strike occurred as part of a much larger wave of attacks across Ukraine, involving over 450 drones and missiles. While Ukraine’s air force intercepted many of these, the strikes still resulted in at least six deaths and dozens of injuries.
paragraphs.zh: 這起事件讓戰爭的現實更貼近歐盟與北約 (NATO) 的邊境。波蘭總理圖斯克 (Donald Tusk) 召開緊急會議討論局勢，表示俄羅斯的行動正逐漸逼近波蘭邊界。根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，這場襲擊是烏克蘭境內更大規模攻擊浪潮的一部分，涉及超過 450 架無人機與飛彈。儘管烏克蘭空軍攔截了其中許多目標，但襲擊仍造成至少 6 人死亡，數十人受傷。

paragraphs.en: Western officials have responded with strong words, viewing the attack as a deliberate message. Kaja Kallas, the EU’s foreign policy chief, accused Russia of trying to scare Western countries. Speaking at a conference in Finland, Kallas said, "I think the question for us is what do we take from that message? I think we should act the opposite." She argued that if Western nations show fear, Russia will achieve its goal of forcing Ukraine to submit. Similarly, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte stated that the strike showed how desperate Vladimir Putin has become. He emphasized that the attack would not stop Western support for Kyiv, adding, "He thinks that he can stop us from supporting Ukraine and that he can undermine our unity. He is wrong."
paragraphs.zh: 西方官員對此做出強烈回應，認為此次攻擊是蓄意的傳遞訊息。歐盟外交與安全政策高級代表卡拉斯 (Kaja Kallas) 指責俄羅斯試圖恐嚇西方國家。卡拉斯在芬蘭的一場會議上表示：「我認為我們面臨的問題是，我們從這個訊息中解讀到了什麼？我認為我們應該採取相反的行動。」她主張，如果西方國家表現出恐懼，俄羅斯將達成其迫使烏克蘭屈服的目標。同樣地，北約秘書長呂特 (Mark Rutte) 表示，這次襲擊顯示普丁已變得多麼絕望。他強調，攻擊不會阻止西方對基輔的支持，並補充說：「他認為可以阻止我們支持烏克蘭，並破壞我們的團結。他錯了。」

paragraphs.en: Boris Johnson, who was on the earlier train, described the event as a "senseless attack" on civilian railway infrastructure. Writing on X, he urged Ukraine’s allies to provide more air defense systems—technology used to detect and destroy incoming missiles or drones—to protect civilians from daily strikes. Former CIA chief David Petraeus, who was also in the area at the time, called the incident "terrifying" and described it as an act by a leader trying to terrorize civilians.
paragraphs.zh: 搭乘前一班列車的強生將此事件描述為針對平民鐵路基礎設施的「無意義攻擊」。他在社群平台 X 上發文，敦促烏克蘭的盟友提供更多防空系統——即用於偵測並摧毀來襲飛彈或無人機的技術——以保護平民免受每日襲擊。當時也在該地區的前美國中央情報局 (CIA) 局長裴卓斯 (David Petraeus) 稱此事件「令人恐懼」，並形容這是試圖恐嚇平民的領導人所為。

paragraphs.en: For its part, Russia has not backed down. When asked about the incident, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters that the Russian military would continue its operations across the entire territory of Ukraine. This stance highlights the ongoing difficulty for Ukraine as it continues to ask for more help from its allies. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha warned that these strikes are a sign of "Putin's terror" reaching the doors of the EU and NATO, and he called for more sanctions—official penalties or restrictions used to punish a country for breaking international rules—against Moscow.
paragraphs.zh: 俄羅斯方面則未退縮。當被問及此事時，克里姆林宮發言人培斯科夫 (Dmitry Peskov) 對記者表示，俄軍將繼續在烏克蘭全境進行行動。這一立場凸顯了烏克蘭在持續向盟友請求更多援助時所面臨的困境。烏克蘭外交部長西比加 (Andrii Sybiha) 警告，這些襲擊是「普丁的恐怖主義」已蔓延至歐盟與北約門口的跡象，並呼籲對莫斯科實施更多制裁——即用於懲罰違反國際規則國家的官方處罰或限制措施。

paragraphs.en: The strike comes at a sensitive time for the European Union. Diplomats in Brussels are currently working on the renewal of sanctions against more than 2,600 Russian individuals and groups. These sanctions are set to expire soon, but disagreements within the EU have delayed the process. As the war continues, the pressure on Western leaders to maintain a united front remains high. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy noted on Telegram that Ukrainians are fighting every day to stop these attacks from spreading further into Europe, emphasizing the importance of international support.
paragraphs.zh: 此次襲擊發生在歐盟的敏感時刻。布魯塞爾的外交官們目前正致力於更新針對超過 2,600 名俄羅斯個人與團體的制裁。這些制裁即將到期，但歐盟內部的分歧延誤了進程。隨著戰爭持續，西方領導人維持統一戰線的壓力依然巨大。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 在通訊軟體 Telegram 上指出，烏克蘭人每天都在戰鬥以阻止這些攻擊進一步蔓延至歐洲，並強調國際支持的重要性。

paragraphs.en: As the situation develops, the focus remains on how Western nations will respond to the increased danger near the border. While Russia continues its military campaign, the message from NATO and EU officials is clear: they intend to continue providing financial and military aid to Ukraine. The attack on the train has served as a reminder that even areas previously considered safer, such as western Ukraine, are now under constant threat. For now, the international community is watching closely to see if the conflict will lead to further escalations near the borders of NATO member states.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著局勢發展，焦點仍集中在西方國家將如何應對邊境附近日益增加的危險。儘管俄羅斯持續其軍事行動，但北約與歐盟官員傳達的訊息很明確：他們打算繼續提供烏克蘭財政與軍事援助。這起火車襲擊事件提醒人們，即使是先前被認為較安全的地區（如烏克蘭西部），現在也處於持續威脅之下。目前，國際社會正密切關注這場衝突是否會導致北約成員國邊境附近的局勢進一步升級。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A feeling of fear or anxiety caused by the realization of danger.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（鬧鐘），這裡指心理上的恐慌。文中：A Russian drone strike hit a passenger train near the Ukraine-Poland border on Sunday, causing alarm among Western leaders.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop demanding something or to stop opposing someone because you have lost confidence or power.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由 back 和 down 組成，意思與字面拆解不同，指在衝突中不願讓步。文中：For its part, Russia has not backed down.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A united group of people or countries working together for a common goal.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（前面），這裡指政治或軍事上的聯合陣線。文中：As the war continues, the pressure on Western leaders to maintain a united front remains high.

The attack occurred shortly after a train carrying former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other Western officials passed through the same station. Ukrainian and Polish authorities reported no injuries, as passengers were evacuated following timely warnings. Polish leaders have held emergency meetings to address the growing risk of escalation near their territory. quiz.question: What prevented the passengers on the train at Yahodyn station from being harmed during the drone strike?

options.A: The train was protected by advanced air defense systems.
options.B: The passengers were evacuated to a safe location shortly before the impact.
options.C: The drone strike missed the passenger train and hit an empty engine instead.
options.D: The high-level diplomats on board ordered the train to stop before reaching the station.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，BBC News 報導指出，由於所有乘客在攻擊發生前 15 分鐘已被轉移至安全地帶，因此無人受傷。選項 A 文中未提及該列車有防空系統保護；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章提到引擎確實被擊中；選項 D 雖然提到外交官，但乘客撤離並非由外交官下令停止列車所致，而是既定的安全程序。

quiz.question: Based on the reactions of Western leaders, what can be inferred about the strategic intent behind the Russian strike?

options.A: Russia intended to specifically assassinate the former UK Prime Minister.
options.B: Russia aimed to destroy the railway infrastructure to stop all train traffic to Poland.
options.C: Russia sought to intimidate Western nations and test their resolve to support Ukraine.
options.D: Russia wanted to signal that it is ready to begin a direct military conflict with NATO.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，歐盟外交政策負責人 Kaja Kallas 指出這是俄羅斯試圖恐嚇西方國家的訊息，而北約秘書長 Mark Rutte 也提到俄羅斯試圖削弱西方對烏克蘭的支持與團結。選項 A 無法由文中證實；選項 B 過於誇大，文中僅提到攻擊基礎設施；選項 D 雖然提到邊境緊張，但文中並未暗示俄羅斯已準備好直接與北約開戰。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'undermine' mean in the context of Mark Rutte's statement?

options.A: To weaken or damage the foundation of something.
options.B: To increase the speed of a process.
options.C: To build a secret tunnel under a structure.
options.D: To provide financial support for a cause.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，Mark Rutte 提到 Putin 認為他可以「undermine our unity」，意指破壞或削弱西方國家之間的團結。此處為抽象用法，指削弱結構或力量。選項 B 與原意相反；選項 C 是該詞的字面意義（挖掘地道），在此處不適用；選項 D 與語境完全相反，因為 Putin 是要破壞而非支持。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the recent drone strike?

options.A: The strike was a minor incident that had little impact on international politics.
options.B: Western leaders are planning to retaliate directly against Russian military bases.
options.C: The attack highlights the escalating threat of the war and the ongoing challenge of maintaining Western unity.
options.D: The incident proves that Ukraine is no longer in need of international military assistance.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文主要探討俄軍攻擊邊境附近的列車，不僅顯示戰爭威脅擴大，也帶出西方國家如何面對俄羅斯的恐嚇，以及歐盟內部在制裁問題上的壓力與維持團結的必要性。選項 A 與事實不符，這是一起引起高度關注的事件；選項 B 文中未提及直接報復計畫；選項 D 與文意完全相反，文章強調烏克蘭仍持續請求盟友協助。
